meta.name: statement_tables
meta.description: 136 E4 (jav/statement_table.py): bank statements exported as a table (a workbook or a CSV file), read by code without AI. A profile names a kind of export by its column headers and says where an account's title, number and balances stand; the header aliases, titles and labels are document vocabulary, quoted as the bank prints them. Decisions: DECISIONS 132 (a general tabular statement reader, not code for one bank; only the two personal accounts of the Revolut export go into the store), DECISIONS 136 (processed as a work package, one statement per account, the accounts chosen by a person before the run).

changelog.note: 153 (review C1): the Erste camt.053 rate pattern reads at most 12 digits and 8 decimals, not after another digit or point, so a crafted 20,000-digit text no longer keeps the reader busy for seconds; what it finds on a real statement is unchanged.

144 (DECISIONS 144): the readers keep a line's facts beyond the money. cib_text_hu: the bank's reference after the kind's semicolon (reference), the parties' end-to-end id and the order id (labels), and a card charge's detail row (card_row: the card, the purchase day and time). cib_card_text_hu: each card's purchases under its KÁRTYASZÁM head (card_section), and the detail row a digits-only drop used to remove (card_row). camt053 (Erste): the card block of the additional information (card, terminal, rate) and the fee text; the references and the acceptance time come from the entry itself. erste_ledger_hu: the same card block on the month's PDF statement. revolut_consolidated_hu: the fee column (Díjak). A card number is kept masked to its first six and last four digits (jav/card_numbers.py).

141 (DECISIONS 141): two profiles. cib_card_text_hu - the CIB credit card statement (HITELKÁRTYA KIVONAT) as text: a line's row prints the booking and the purchase day and the amount, no running balance (the statement checks its closing balance and printed totals); the merchant is the first unlabelled row after it (name_from first_unlabelled), a purchase's amount in its own currency is its own row (original_row); drop_rows - rows left out (the repeated table header, card and reference numbers). camt053 - a bank's ISO 20022 camt.053 XML statement (layout camt053): banks by BIC give the texts of the bank's own transaction codes (kinds, as its Excel export prints them) and the patterns of its card details (details: merchant, original); the Erste codes are the 25 its 2022-2026 statements use. The text profiles also read a number the PDF prints with every character twice (the first row after a page break). The other profiles are unchanged.

141 (DECISIONS 141, the sports club's statements read by code first): the text layout and its first profile, the CIB bank statement (a current account or an investment client account), read from its PDF's text layer or from the bank's fixed-width text export (cp1250). signature: patterns every one of which the text holds; header: the statement number, period, currency, giro and IBAN numbers, opening and closing balances and the printed totals; the lines stand between lines_start and lines_end, without the page breaks (skip_blocks: a page's footer to the next page's period, and the table header); line: booking date, kind, signed amount, running balance; value_line: the value date and its text (the counterparty's account, a foreign transfer's original amount, or the bank's description of a fee); labels: the counterparty's name and account and the memo; labelled: a row that is no counterparty's name. The credit card statement (HITELKÁRTYA KIVONAT) has another layout and is not read by this profile. The other profiles are unchanged.

140 (DECISIONS 137, 139, 140; jav/statement_package.py): package - the statement package of an own party and a period. accepted_parents: the coarse detection categories (configs/doc_types.json) a PDF of such a package may have; a PDF recognised as anything else stops after its type is recognised, with a statements:not_a_statement to-do and without an extraction. The reading of the exports is unchanged.

137 (DECISIONS 137, 'XML + PDF by code'): the ledger layout and its first profile, the Erste Excel 2003 XML export (one row per line with its account and statement number, the amount as a number, no balance; a card line names no merchant). One statement per account and statement number, the period from the file name's month. Its companion is the same month's PDF statement next to the export or in a pdf subfolder: its text layer gives the period, the account, the opening and closing balances and every line with its running balance, the merchant (Elfogadó) and a foreign purchase's original amount and currency (Tr.összeg). New limit: max_files, the export files read from one folder.

136: first version, the Hungarian Revolut consolidated statement (an Excel workbook whose first column holds the CSV records, UTF-8 read as cp1250): the account summaries with the IBAN and the opening and closing balances, then one transaction table per account ending in a total row; the period is printed in the file name only.
